scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.speaker: Rose
scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.text: \Raya do Pastrana Park. \Tanan nag \tawo ga \tikang iya kon \agahon.
scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.translation: This is Pastrana Park. Everyone walks here in the morning.

scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.speaker: Player
scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.text: It's nice here. Peaceful, unlike the busy streets in the States.

scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.speaker: Rose
scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.text: Wait until festival season. Not peaceful at all then. But that's later.

scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.speaker: Rose
scene_1_pastrana_park_morning_walk.text: Look around first, balikbayan. Talk to me when you want to keep going.

scene_1_meet_pedring.speaker: Rose
scene_1_meet_pedring.text: Ruyon, si Anong Pedring. \Suki namon \igto sa tindahan.
scene_1_meet_pedring.translation: That's Anong Pedring. He's our regular vendor at the market.

scene_1_meet_pedring.text: Will you talk to Anong Pedring?

choices.label: Good morning! I'm here with Jonabel's family.
Uh, hi. Sorry, I'm still nervous speaking Akeanon.
I'll just wait here, you go ahead.

scene_1_meet_pedring.speaker: Anong Pedring
scene_1_meet_pedring.text: \Mayad-ayad nga agahon! \Apo gali ni Jonabel. \Siin ka \halin?

scene_1_meet_pedring.speaker: Rose
scene_1_meet_pedring.text: Suit yourself. But you'll have to talk to people eventually.

scene_1_meet_pedring.speaker: Rose
scene_1_meet_pedring.text: \Sunod \kamo sa market. Iya kita \magtuon it mga \pangaean.
scene_1_meet_pedring.translation: Follow us to the market. This is where we'll learn some names of things.

scene_2_kalibo_public_market.text: The market is full of color and noise — fruits, fish, cloth, everything mixed together. The smell of dried fish and freshly cooked rice fills the air.

scene_2_kalibo_public_market.speaker: Rose
scene_2_kalibo_public_market.text: Go on, look around. Talk to me when you are done.

scene_2_market_talk.speaker: Anong Pedring
scene_2_market_talk.translation: What do you want, grandchild? There's plenty here — rice, water, fish.

scene_2_market_talk.speaker: Player
scene_2_market_talk.text: Rose, how do I say I want this?

scene_2_market_talk.speaker: Rose
scene_2_market_talk.text: Say "\pangabay" first. Means please. Basic manners, balikbayan.
Player points at a round fruit, unfamiliar.

scene_2_market_talk.speaker: Anong Pedring
scene_2_market_talk.translation: Star-shaped fruit — star fruit, grandchild. Very sweet.

choices.label: Yes, pangabay, I'd like to try it.
Maybe later, let me look around first.
I'm okay, I'm not a fan of exotic fruits, sorry.

scene_2_market_talk.speaker: Anong Pedring
scene_2_market_talk.text: That's fine, my goods won't disappear quickly.

scene_2_market_talk.speaker: Rose
scene_2_market_talk.text: Your loss. This is literally one of the best things here.

scene_2_market_talk.speaker: Anong Pedring
scene_2_market_talk.translation: Where are you headed next, to church?

scene_3_kalibo_cathedral_midday.text: A large church, strong walls, people going in and out — everyday life, not just for festivals.

scene_3_kalibo_cathedral_midday.speaker: Rose
scene_3_kalibo_cathedral_midday.text: Take your time, balikbayan. Talk to me when you are ready.

scene_3_cathedral_talk.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: Iya \kami \tanan gasimba. Inyo nga \Lola Jonabel \gid, pinakamasueundun.
scene_3_cathedral_talk.translation: This is where we all used to go to church. Your Lola Jonabel especially, she was the most devout.

scene_3_cathedral_talk.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: (laughs) Don't believe her, \Apo. We were all equally naughty back then.
The group sits outside the church, Rose holding a town map.

scene_3_cathedral_talk.speaker: Rose
scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: \Hara, tan-awa. \Mapa it Kalibo. Kon \magtuon ka it mga \lugar, mas \madali ka \makaagto bisan siin.
scene_3_cathedral_talk.translation: Here, look at this. Map of Kalibo. If you learn the places, you'll find your way anywhere more easily.

scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: What will you say to Rose?

choices.label: This is actually really helpful. Saeamat, Rose.
I'll try to remember the names, no promises though.
A physical map? Can't I just use my phone?

scene_3_cathedral_talk.speaker: Rose
scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: See, not completely hopeless after all.

scene_3_cathedral_talk.speaker: Rose
scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: That's more effort than I expected, honestly.

scene_3_cathedral_talk.speaker: Rose
scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: Sure, and when your phone dies, then what, balikbayan?

scene_3_cathedral_talk.speaker: Rose
scene_3_cathedral_talk.text: Ro sunod nga \lugar nga aton agtunan hay medyo \maeayo — ro manughaboe it \piña fiber. Iya mo makita ro \matuod nga \ubra it mga \Akeanon.
scene_3_cathedral_talk.translation: Next place we'll go is a bit far — the piña weaving area. There you'll see real Aklanon craftsmanship.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Before leaving the cathedral grounds, they pass by a small souvenir shop full of colorful items.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Round two. \An-om, \pito, \waeo, \siyam, \napueo — six through ten. Finish counting to ten this time.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: \Isaea, \daywa, \tatlo, \ap-at, \lima, \an-om, \pito, \waeo, \siyam, \napueo. Ten! I did it.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Now, colors — look at the fabrics there.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: \Puti — white. \Itom — black. \Puea — red. \Asul — blue. \Dueaw — yellow. \Berdi — green.
Which color do you like?

choices.label: I like the puea one — the red one. It really stands out.
Maybe the puti, the white one. Simple.
Honestly, I can't tell half these colors apart yet, sorry Rose.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Good eye. Bold color for a bold first attempt at counting.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Safe choice. That works too.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: They'll stick eventually. Nobody gets it all at once.
Rose shows a small stone, then a big stone, for comparison.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: \Maisot — small. \Mabahoe — big. \Mayad — good. \Bag-o — new. \Daan — old.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: \Daya — "this." \Haron — "that," closer to me. \Dato — "that," farther away. Point when you say it, it's easier.
While walking toward the market, Rose points at food items — fish, chicken, eggs, rice.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: \Isda — fish. \Manok — chicken. \Itlog — egg. \Humay — rice. \Tinapay — bread. \Karne — meat. \Baboy — pig.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Okay, that's a lot of food words. Good thing we're heading to the market.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Exactly why I taught them now. Use it or lose it, balikbayan.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Not so fast. Let's see if you know what they mean.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Not bad. You were listening.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Almost. Say them again on the way home.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Now let's test your eyes. Look at each color and tell me its name.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Good. You know your colors now.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_number.text: Not bad for a first try. Look at the fabrics again later.

scene_0_home_atlast.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_0_home_atlast.text: That flight must have worn you all out. Go on upstairs and sleep in your rooms.

scene_0_home_atlast.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_0_home_atlast.text: Look next to the doors. Yours is the one with the \bituon.
scene_0_home_atlast.translation: Yours is the one with the star.

scene_0_home_atlast.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_0_home_atlast.text: Jonabel has the \buean, and Jobert has the \adlaw.
scene_0_home_atlast.translation: Jonabel has the moon, and Jobert has the sun.

scene_0b_ask_rose.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_0b_ask_rose.text: There you are! Did you sleep well?

scene_0b_ask_rose.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_0b_ask_rose.text: Whenever you want to look around, always ask Rose to go with you.

scene_sunday_mass_invite.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_sunday_mass_invite.text: It's Sunday! Rose and I are going to the cathedral for mass, then to the market after.

choices.label: Sure, I'll go with you.
Maybe another time.
I'll come
Maybe next time

scene_sunday_mass_invite.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_sunday_mass_invite.text: Good! Let's go before all the seats are taken.

scene_sunday_mass_invite.speaker: Rose
scene_sunday_mass_invite.text: Suit yourself. We'll be back by noon.

choices.label: Can you show me around?
Not right now

scene_rose_walk_to_park.speaker: Rose
scene_rose_walk_to_park.text: Finally. Let's start with the park. Stay close.

choices.label: Can we go out again?
Not right now

scene_rose_walk_to_park.speaker: Rose
scene_rose_walk_to_park.text: Back to the park, then. Stay close.

choices.label: Can we go out again?
Can we go to Bakhawan?
Not right now

scene_rose_not_now.speaker: Rose
scene_rose_not_now.text: Not now, balikbayan. Ask me in the morning.

scene_mass_market.speaker: Lola Susan
scene_mass_market.text: That's everything. Let's go home before the food gets cold.
